name: Smoked Salmon Soba Noodle Bowl with Cucumber, Edamame & Avocado

instructions.primary_message: Fill a medium saucepan about halfway with hot water (from the tap); cover with a lid and bring to a boil over high heat.
Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
2 (1 inch) pieces ginger root
1 English cucumber
1 avocado

instructions.primary_message: Peel and mince or grate the ginger. Transfer to a small bowl.
Add soy sauce, vinegar, oil, and honey to the bowl and whisk to combine.
instructions.secondary_message:
2 tbsp rice vinegar
2 tsp toasted sesame oil
1 tsp honey

instructions.primary_message: Once the water in the saucepan is boiling, add the noodles and edamame; cook according to package directions, about 5 minutes. Once done, drain and rinse thoroughly under cold water. Return to the saucepan and toss with 2 tbsp of the dressing.
instructions.secondary_message:
12 oz soba (buckwheat) noodles
1 ½ cups edamame

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, thinly slice cucumber into match-like sticks.
Halve and pit the avocado. Slice thinly while still in the skin and scoop out with a spoon.
To serve, divide noodles and edamame between bowls and top with smoked salmon, cucumbers, and avocado. Drizzle with remaining dressing and enjoy!
